summary:
I wrote the DOCS-54 plan draft (134 lines). I edited nothing except the plan and my notes file. I got the line numbers from origin/main 82c605e and the merge facts from the GitHub REST API; history.md ranges are taken at 110c303.

Two things to know before using it:

1. **His word is shorter than the task quotes.** The computed task says history.md:2204-2227 holds DOCS-54 (a) as "(a) Yes. This chat opens one branch (claude/docs-after-54)...". It doesn't. That long text is the advisor's draft (advisor-main-54-full.json, docs54.for_mustafa). The question history.md records as last put to him (line 2215) has only "(a) yes", and his reply is "I agree with all your recommendations, continue" (line 2205). So the branch name, the plan-first step, the one review round and the wait for his go come from the advisor and the protocol, not from him. Plan §0 never quotes the long form as his words.
2. **The history.md headings use his own time labels, not when he typed.** For example, KEPT-LOGS is labelled "08:20 Amsterdam" but the transcript shows it typed at 12:01:41 UTC. The plan's DECISIONS.md headers use the transcript times and quote his labels.

**What is out of date on main** (all listed in plan §1):
- **STATUS:**
  - :5 still says last updated 2026-11-14 for 4d21c1a.
  - :13-14 still says the last merge was #48.
  - :15-16 does not list his two one-change exceptions to the kit freeze (#53 and #54).
  - :21-23 gives CI runs on 4d21c1a.
  - :29 still has #52 as an open row.
  - :35-39 and :43 are still waiting on #52.
  - :73-75 lacks the follow-ups from #53 (SA-KL-1 to -4, KLT-1 to -8) and #54 (ADV-NS-L2 to -L4, SA-NS-2, and NS-TRAILER and NS-FIRST, which he answered (b)).
  - STATUS is already at its 120-line cap. The plan pays for the additions by turning the four-line quote at :36-39, which is already in DECISIONS.md, into a pointer.
- **ROADMAP:** :117-124 still calls #52 "in review", and :97 is stale. Adding three entries (#53, #54 and this PR) means moving the three oldest (:212-217) by script into "Build history".
- **STATUS_ARCHIVE:** needs rows for #52, #53 and #54 above :159, and two follow-up subsections after :869.
- **DECISIONS:** has no entry after 2026-11-13. KIT-FREEZE-2's record (:27-37) needs a dated pointer to the two exceptions.
- **REPO_MAP:** no file path changes. One description is out of date: :80 lists CHECKPOINTS.md sections up to §10 but not the new §11.
- **The five other docs** (START_HERE, MODULE_MAP, TECHNICAL, ART_DIRECTION, ANIMATION_PLAN) say nothing that #53 or #54 made untrue. A grep found no hits.

**Things I found along the way:**
- **His go for #52 is missing from main.** It was given on 2026-11-14 at 09:02:29 UTC in the foundation chat and is quoted whole only in merge commit 4460ef5's message. It belongs in DECISIONS.md, copied by script from that commit, as #52 did for #48. It is not in history.md.
- **PR #40's branch already edits some of the same places.** These are STATUS :28 (#40's own row), DECISIONS around :723, and in the archive :106, :289 and the tops of "Open bugs and risks" and "Health". The plan leaves all of them alone so #40 doesn't hit merge conflicts. This means #40's row on main stays out of date (open question Q2).
- **Where his words are kept may not last.** history.md is deleted before #40 is marked ready, and #40 merges by squash, so the branch commit cited as the source may stop being reachable. Each DECISIONS.md header therefore also names the transcript time, and the hash table goes into the PR description and the commit message.

**Method** (plan §3):
- **Branch:** a worktree for the new branch; the main folder never switches.
- **Copy script:** one Python script run with -I. It refuses a second run and checks each copied block's sha256 against history.md. It also checks the three night-shift lines byte for byte against NIGHT_SHIFT.md:45-47 on main, checks the #52 go against its merge commit, and compares each of his blocks with the session transcript.
- **Checks:** the gate with `--no-smoke` (borrowing the main folder's modules, as for #54), repo-map-check and a line count on STATUS.
- **Review:** one round, the verifier plus the advisor agent on every pushed head. Then his go.

Size is about 230 changed lines; docs only, risk tier 1, label `needs-mustafa`. Mustafa has nothing to check in Brave.

open_questions: DOCS-54 wording: what he answered (history.md:2215) has only '(a) yes'. The long option text with the branch name comes from the advisor's draft (advisor-main-54-full.json). Should the advisor confirm that his 'I agree with all your recommendations' covers the branch name claude/docs-after-54 and the advisor-and-one-round method, which the plan treats as protocol rather than his words?

Q1: should his whole 2026-11-14 11:07 UTC message (SIZE-CHECK, COMPACT-WAIT, MAIN-52; history.md:2039-2086) stay with PR #40? The computed task listed these as possibly project-wide. I recommend keeping them with #40: SIZE-CHECK applies his netcode-unit rule of 2026-11-10 (history.md:398-399), COMPACT-WAIT is how this chat waits for his /compact, and MAIN-52 is when #40 takes main in.

Q2: should main's STATUS row for #40 (:28, still citing d0d1cfd) stay out of date until #40 updates it? #40's branch already edits that line, so changing it here would cause a merge conflict. I recommend leaving it.
Q3: should the report go into a new file under docs/reports/ (one new path for REPO_MAP), or only into the PR description? I recommend the PR description only.
Q4: REPO_MAP :80 (the CHECKPOINTS.md row) misses §11. That is a description fix, not a path change. Is it in this PR's scope? I recommend yes: one clause, tagged [verified].

Partial copies: for messages that mix project and lane decisions, the plan copies only the project lines and names the left-out lines in the header, never inside his quote. Copying the whole messages is the other option, but #40 would then record the same words again. Which does the advisor prefer?

Not yet checked: whether checkpoint.mjs save works from a linked worktree (a plain git commit with [skip ci] is the fallback), and the CI runs on main 4460ef5 and 53272a1 (to be read with the REST check-runs API at build time, otherwise left out).
